description: This file defines a command handler class for deleting an account number format in the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and is annotated as a Service and CommandType, indicating its role within the command handling architecture. The core method, processCommand, delegates the deletion operation to the accountNumberFormatWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteAccountNumberFormatCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the deletion of account number formats by processing commands and delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming JSON command to delete an account number format and returns the result after invoking the write platform service.
